name: GiveWell
about: Evaluates global health and poverty programs; publishes detailed cost-effectiveness spreadsheets for its top charities.

name: Animal Charity Evaluators
about: Evaluates animal advocacy charities; estimates suffering-adjusted days averted per dollar.

name: Happier Lives Institute
about: Evaluates charities by their effect on wellbeing, in wellbeing-adjusted life years (WELLBYs).

name: Ambitious Impact
about: Formerly Charity Entrepreneurship. Researches intervention ideas and incubates new charities to run the best of them; publishes a cost-effectiveness analysis with each idea report.

name: charityevals
about: Our own models, where no evaluator has published one.
